description: This file defines a React functional component named 'CheckoutModal' which provides a modal dialog for users to review payment and shipping details, and to confirm placing an order. It handles state for loading and errors, interacts with an API to checkout the cart, and calls callback functions on close and confirm actions.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Asynchronous function to handle the order placement process, including token validation, calling checkout API, and error handling.
